source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Вианора и Силуана (IV).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, second name, and this folder’s man — name page 1989, «Силуан Писидийский, мч.», «День памяти: 10 июля» and no other day. The epithet is the calendar’s and is the companion’s, not his own country: the reading makes him a bystander at Bianor’s torments who believed on the spot. THE READING life4211 WAS OPENED, and in it he is the one who had his tongue cut out and his head struck off the moment he declared his faith, before Bianor’s own beheading. `dates` STILL NULL AND DELIBERATELY SO, for the same reason as his companion’s: «(IV)» on the line against a martyrdom the reading says is of unknown date and only SUPPOSED to be under Diocletian. `types` UNCHANGED, and no `confessor` was added. HE IS NOT THE SILVANUS OF THE DAY’S SEVENTH ENTRY: that is «Прп. Силуана , схимника Печерского (XIII-XIV).», the Kyiv Caves schemamonk, whose folder is `silouan-of-the-kyiv-caves` and whose name page is 1988, and whose entry is withheld here for the reason below. Two Silvanuses on one day, two name pages, two folders. TWO ENTRIES OF THIS DAY WERE WITHHELD AND ARE NAMED IN THE REPORT, both folders already carrying a VENERATED russian row on another Julian day: `anthony-of-the-caves` on 2 сентября (three hymns on this page left uncopied) and `silouan-of-the-kyiv-caves` on 10 июня — whose own row-note already records that his name page lists 10 июля as a day it did not read, and whose two hymns were taken there. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 forbids a draft on such a folder and BRIEF.md §4 sanctions a second-day note; the author has not ruled, so nothing was written for either. LEFT OUT of this day: «Положение честной ризы Господа нашего Иисуса Христа в Москве (1625)», the laying up of the Lord’s robe, which is a feast and not a person, with its troparion, kontakion and величание; and the Konevskaya icon with its two hymns.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Siluan»

attestations.note: The day prints the two men on separate lines and both link to one short page, «Sfinții Mucenici Vianor și Siluan», so the corpus keeps one folder for each. Nothing on the page identifies him with Silouan the Athonite or with any other Silvanus.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Βιάνωρ και Σιλουανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the Greek page gives him the same part the folder's byname does: the bystander who watched Bianor's torture, believed, confessed Christ before the idolaters, and lost his tongue and then his head. That office settles him against the corpus's other men named Silvanus, none of whom is kept on this day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under their line.
